text:
matt: Heads up — aps2a-rack7 just had a thermal flare cluster: 3 nodes reported short thermal excursions over the last 6m, gpu-node-7 experienced a hard reset and ECC errors on GPU0/GPU1. I'm starting a drain for the affected node and will promote a spare. Link: https://pg.redwood/ops/mon/aps2a/rack7 :eyes:

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-4052 — Severity: degraded-capacity — Assigned: eng-infra/oncall — Pager: matt, dave

ben: Are we seeing cross-rack correlation or just rack7?

carla: Mostly rack7. Metric snapshots: ECC error rate spike at 17:24 UTC, temp spike to 92C on gpu-node-7 then node hard reset. KV cache eviction rate up 4x for aps2-medium. No system-wide network errors. https://pg.redwood/graphs/aps2a/ecc-spike

matt: Commanding cordon/drain now. Will also update smart-routing to shift traffic off the aps2a-hosted pool to aps2-fallback. Running:
```
# cordon + drain node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 -n infra
kdrain --node gpu-node-7 --timeout 15m --evict-local
```

dave: Before draining, ensure the fallback pools have capacity. Ben/Carla — can you spin up 4x small gpus in aps2-fallback and bump autoscaler min? If autoscaler takes >5m we'll do manual routing change.

ben: Spinning up 4x aps2-small now. ETA ~3m. Note: if we keep fallback >12h, cost delta ~+$1.2k/day for prod traffic.

emily: Ops-field booked a tech for onsite diagnostics (ops-field) — ETA 6h for RMA unless spares suffice. ops-field: confirmed, we'll triage on arrival and swap PSUs/boards as needed.

matt: Promoting spare from aps2-spares to replace gpu-node-7. Reprovision command:
```
provision --region aps2a --pool aps2-spares --target gpu-node-7-replacement --image rwd-inference-2026-02
```

carla: Drain progress: eviction started, 12 inference jobs killed but migrated to fallback. KV cache warmups spiking but within expected. ECC logs continuing to report transient correctable errors on gpu-node-7: sample:
```
[17:26:12] GPU0 ECC CORRECTABLE @ addr 0x7ff4c2b... count +1
[17:26:15] GPU1 ECC CORRECTABLE @ addr 0x3b9f0a... count +1
[17:26:30] driver: node rebooted (watchdog reset)
```

dave: Good. After replacement, run a 1h soak with synthetic traffic and ECC monitor rule enabled. If errors reappear on replacement, escalate to hw team for full RMA.

matt: Routing change applied: smart-router policy updated to deprioritize aps2a-hosted and prefer aps2-fallback for new requests. Command used:
```
redwoodctl routing update --region aps2a --policy shift=aps2-fallback --drain-mode gradual --window 15m
```

ben: Confirming autoscaler increased target and nodes are coming up. New nodes should handle ~70% of the shifted load. Remaining ~30% will use cached KV shards.

carla: Evac complete for gpu-node-7. Node marked drained and cordoned. Replacement provisioning in progress. No user-facing errors reported beyond slight latency bump (p95 +120ms). :thumbsup:

matt: Notifying support and customers with affected SLA workstreams. I'll keep INC-4052 updated. If anyone sees repeat ECC on spares, ping immediately.

ops-field: Onsite tech confirmed spare promotion OK, will perform physical swap if the replacement fails soak.

dave: Current ETA to full capacity: ~2h (provision + soak). I'll keep watchers on ECC, thermals, and router health. Reopen thread for any regression. :eyes:

matt: Thanks all — post-mortem and cost impact calc to follow once we close the incident. For now primary action items: 1) complete replacement + soak (matt/ops-field), 2) monitor ECC trends for 24h (carla), 3) compute cost delta and ops hours (ben).
